settings.learners.title: Learners

settings.learning.title: {name}’s learning
settings.voice.title: Voice & privacy
settings.voice.keep.label: Keep recordings on this device
settings.voice.keep.detail: Lets learners replay “before” and “now”. Only the newest 3 per phrase are kept. Off = audio is discarded right after scoring.
settings.voice.leave.scored: Recordings never leave this device except to be scored by the speech service, which does not keep them — unless you choose to share them below.
settings.voice.leave.never: Recordings never leave this device — unless you choose to share them below.
settings.voice.teacher: The teacher’s voice is made from lesson text only — learners’ voices are never sent for that.
settings.share.row.title: Share recordings for testing
settings.share.row.ready: Help check the app on real voices: make a file you can send to the Wunder Tutor team
settings.share.row.empty: Nothing to share yet — recordings appear here after speaking practice
settings.share.body.adult.one: This makes one file on this device with {n} practice recording, what you were asked to say, and the app’s scores. It includes your age, home language and settings — **no name**.
settings.share.body.adult.other: This makes one file on this device with {n} practice recordings, what you were asked to say, and the app’s scores. It includes your age, home language and settings — **no name**.
settings.share.body.kid.one: This makes one file on this device with {n} practice recording, what {name} was asked to say, and the app’s scores. It includes {name}’s age, home language and settings — **no name**.
settings.share.body.kid.other: This makes one file on this device with {n} practice recordings, what {name} was asked to say, and the app’s scores. It includes {name}’s age, home language and settings — **no name**.
settings.share.nothingSent: Nothing is sent. You choose who to give the file to. The Wunder Tutor team uses it only to test and improve how the app checks pronunciation.
settings.share.consent: I am this learner’s parent or guardian (or the learner, if an adult). I agree to share these practice recordings with the Wunder Tutor team, only to test and improve how the app checks pronunciation. I can ask for them to be deleted at any time.
settings.share.none: No recordings could be read on this device
settings.share.failed: Couldn’t make the file on this device
settings.delete.recordings.title: Delete {name}’s recordings?
settings.delete.recordings.body: All saved voice recordings are erased from this device. Scores and progress are kept.
settings.delete.history.title: Delete pronunciation history?
settings.delete.history.body: Recordings, scores, weak-sound memory and review schedule for {name} are erased. Lessons completed, the pages in My book, XP and badges are kept.
settings.delete.profile.title: Delete {name}’s profile?
settings.delete.profile.body: Everything about this learner is erased from this device. This can’t be undone.
settings.delete.everything.title: Delete the whole account?
settings.delete.everything.body: All learners, recordings, scores and settings are erased from this device. If you are signed in, your family account and everything saved in it is erased too. This can’t be undone.
settings.account.title: Family account
settings.account.why: Sign in to keep your learners’ progress, scores and saved pages in an account: nothing is lost with a phone, and every device in the family shows the same. Voice recordings never leave this device.
settings.account.email.label: Your email address
settings.account.consent: By signing in you agree that your learners’ nicknames, ages, settings, progress, scores and the text of their saved pages are kept in your Wunder Tutor account. No recordings, no photos. You can delete the account, with everything in it, here at any time.
settings.account.sent: We sent an email to {email}. Type the code from it here, or open the link in it on this device.
settings.account.code.label: The code from the email
settings.account.signedIn: Signed in as {email}. Learners on this device are saved to your account.
settings.account.sync.saved: Everything is saved. Changes are saved by themselves as you go.
settings.account.sync.offline: No internet: changes are kept on this device and saved when it is back.
settings.account.sync.failed: The account can’t be reached right now. Changes are kept on this device and saved later.
settings.account.full: An account holds 8 learners. The others stay on this device only.
settings.account.error.email: That email address doesn’t look right.
settings.account.error.code: That code isn’t right, or it has expired. Check the newest email, or send a new code.
settings.account.error.wait: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
settings.account.error.failed: That didn’t work. Try again in a moment.
settings.account.delete.failed: The account couldn’t be deleted just now, so nothing was erased. Check the internet connection and try again.
settings.look.title: Appearance
settings.beta.title: Invite code
settings.beta.accepted: Invite code accepted — real pronunciation scoring and the teacher voice are on.
settings.beta.noCodeSet: This Wunder Tutor server has no invite code set yet, so no code can unlock it.
settings.beta.unreachable: The server couldn’t be reached to check this code. Check your connection, then save it again.
settings.beta.refused: That code wasn’t accepted. Check it and try again.
settings.beta.prompt: Enter your invite code to switch on real pronunciation scoring and the teacher voice. Without it the app uses its built-in practice mode.
settings.beta.label: Invite code
settings.conn.title: Connections
settings.demo.title: Demo & diagnostics
settings.demo.mic.label: Demo microphone
settings.demo.mic.detail: Simulates speaking so the app can be shown on a device without a mic. Scores are not real.
